card.name: Inside long drug and proper names
card.fires_on: Fires on a middle piece of a rare, multi-part word, most often a drug name such as azilsartan, olmesartan, erdafitinib or benztropine. It also fires inside a few foreign or proper names such as Poincaré.

modes.label: Drug names
modes.description: A middle piece of a long generic drug name, before the rest of the name is spelled out.

modes.label: Proper and foreign names
modes.description: A middle piece of a name or foreign term in general text.

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated, so no single clear continuation is suggested; the pole mostly supports word pieces that continue a rare word.
card.plain: It lights up partway through an unusual long name, such as a drug name, when more letters are still to come.
